Moonlit Aquarium

Two hours of moonlit aquarium ambience with gentle underwater sounds and no music, for winding down or a calm background at bedtime.

fig. 01 about this film

What you'll see and hear

An original real-time 3D aquarium, with softly moving fish, moonlit water and a restrained underwater soundscape. This is a virtual scene, not footage or field recordings from a real reef. The fish models were made with the help of generative AI.

Recorded in 3840 × 2160 at 60 frames per second. No music or spoken introduction.

Created by Greenfield Studio.
